name: Necker Island
insider_take: Sir Richard Branson's crown jewel in the British Virgin Islands - a 74-acre private paradise where celebrities and royalty escape to one of the world's most exclusive retreats.
whats_special: This is the ultimate private island experience where you rent the entire island. During several "Celebration Weeks, a single unit can be rented rather than the whole island!. The Great House accommodates up to 34 guests across multiple Balinese-style villas, each with stunning 360-degree ocean views. The island generates its own renewable energy and features a team of 100 staff members who cater to every whim, from private chefs to water sports instructors.
pro_tip: Book during flamingo season (winter months) when these pink beauties migrate to the island's salt ponds, creating an Instagram-worthy spectacle that few will ever witness first-hand.
dont_miss: The weekly beach party with fire shows and steel drum bands, kite surfing lessons in the crystalline waters, and tennis matches on the cliff-top court where you might just play alongside a Hollywood A-lister. The island's lemurs, rescued and rehomed here, often join guests for breakfast on the terrace.
pros: Exclusive private island ownership by Virgin Group
Ultra-luxury all-inclusive experience with world-class amenities
Pristine Caribbean setting with exceptional water sports facilities
Unparalleled privacy and personalized service for discerning guests
cons: Remote location requires helicopter or boat transfer
